values.binNote: 0.5s interval is not a separate bin data value; it is implied by Duration=3 / DotTicks=6, neither of which is itself an interval field.

values.meaning: total self-heal over Dream Dust duration against champions
values.binNote: The wiki's pplevel formula 6 + ((90-6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) is quadratic in level and does not match the bin's LilliaP#ChampionHeal byLevel(1..15) curve (which multiplied by DotTicks=6 gives a linearly-interpolated 6..90 progression, e.g. level 10 = 55.41 vs wiki's 49.36). The two sources disagree on the level curve shape; flat values here follow the wiki's stated formula, not the bin's byLevel array.

mechanics.claim: All of Lillia's abilities apply Dream Dust to enemies they hit, which deals damage over time and heals her simultaneously.
Lilting Lullaby's sleep application does not apply Dream Dust, but the damage it triggers does.
mechanics.quote: {{ais|Lilting Lullaby|Lillia}} application does not apply ''Dream Dust'', but its triggering damage does.

mechanics.claim: Dream Dust is applied even if the ability's damage is prevented by a shield or invulnerability, but not if the ability itself is prevented (e.g. by spell shield).
mechanics.quote: ''Dream Dust'' is applied even if the target takes no damage from an ability, e.g. by being {{tip|shield|shielded}} or {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}}, but not when the ability hit is prevented in the first place (e.g. {{tip|spell shield}})

mechanics.claim: Dream-Laden Bough's damage is persistent, indirect damage, and applies spell effects (i.e. on-hit-adjacent effects) as it ticks.
mechanics.quote: ''Dream-Laden Bough'' deals {{tip|persistent damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.

mechanics.claim: Lillia can only be healed by Dream Dust against one monster at a time.
mechanics.quote: She may only heal against 1 monster at a time.
